title: Suspicious local scheduled task creation
description: Detects local Schtasks task creation whose task action contains a selected user-writable payload or behavior-bearing script and proxy-execution command.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may create a local scheduled task that executes a script, user-writable payload or signed Windows utility for persistence or execution.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents scheduled task creation across execution, persistence and privilege escalation. Combining local Schtasks creation with a task action and selected payload behavior is more useful than alerting on every local task, while the separate remote-task rule retains ownership of commands using the documented remote /s option.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify local Schtasks creation commands whose /tr action uses a selected user-writable payload or suspicious PowerShell, Mshta, Regsvr32 or Rundll32 behavior while leaving remote creation, ordinary managed tasks, queries and unrelated processes unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Validate the task action, creator and schedule before escalation; software deployment and administrative automation can create local tasks with interpreters or user-space paths.
steps: Review the complete Schtasks command, task name, schedule, /tr action, original filename, parent process, account and endpoint role.
Inspect the referenced payload or remote resource and correlate its file creation, signer, hash, download, child processes and task execution events.
Confirm the task with the responsible deployment or automation owner; otherwise disable it safely, contain the endpoint and investigate the originating process and account.
false_positives: Approved local software deployment, maintenance or administrative automation that creates a task with one of the selected payload forms

validation.expected_outcome: Match local Schtasks /create commands with a /tr action containing a selected user-writable payload or suspicious script and LOLBin behavior; do not match remote creation, ordinary Program Files tasks, queries or unrelated executables.
